Welcome! This is the arena for the **Top PM Rankings** — the 100 product managers who changed the world, scored across six attributes (Vision / Insight / Taste / Business / Scale / Originality) **entirely by Claude, Anthropic's AI model**. Steve Jobs holds the board's only 99.

**The whole point of this repo: the numbers are challengeable.**

- 🥊 Think a score is wrong? [Challenge it](https://github.com/zhitongblog/top-pm-rankings/issues/new?template=challenge-score.yml) with product decisions and public facts. Win the argument, and the number changes — on the live board too.
- 🙋 Someone missing? [Nominate them](https://github.com/zhitongblog/top-pm-rankings/issues/new?template=nominate.yml). The board holds exactly 99 seats + 1 reserved — someone in means someone out, so tell us who to drop.
- 💬 Everything else (ordering hot takes, criteria debates, "how is Ford above Hastings"): right here in Discussions.

Ground rules: we judge **product decisions, not people**; public facts only.

Live board: https://doaipm.com/en/rankings/ · Daily deep-dives light the list up one name at a time, starting with [No. 1, Steve Jobs](https://doaipm.com/en/blog/steve-jobs-the-only-99/).

欢迎！这里是「顶级产品经理排名」的擂台——改变世界的 100 个产品经理，六个维度（远见/洞察/品味/商业/规模/开创）打分，**全部分数由 Claude（AI）独立打出**，乔布斯是全榜唯一的 99。

**这个仓库存在的意义就一句话：分数是可以吵的。**

- 🥊 觉得哪个分不对？[来吵](https://github.com/zhitongblog/top-pm-rankings/issues/new?template=challenge-score.yml)——只认产品决策和公开事实，吵赢了就改，官网榜单同步改。
- 🙋 觉得有人该上榜？[提名](https://github.com/zhitongblog/top-pm-rankings/issues/new?template=nominate.yml)——榜单只有 99 席，有人上就有人下，记得说清该换下谁。
- 💬 其他一切（排序暴论、标准之争、「福特凭什么压哈斯廷斯」）：就在讨论区聊。

规矩：**评产品决策，不评人身**，只谈公开事实。

在线榜单：https://doaipm.com/zh/rankings/ · 每天一篇正篇把名单点亮，第一篇：[第 1 位，乔布斯](https://doaipm.com/zh/blog/steve-jobs-the-only-99/)。
